# Intentional Mode

The abstract category of intrinsic intentional moments — desires and intentions — that inhere in exactly one agent and aim at a goal. The intrinsic branch of gmeow:IntentionalMoment. Never instantiated directly: instances are Desires or Intentions (the commitment-graded trichotomy; the social grade is gmeow:Commitment, a relator, not a mode).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/IntentionalMode>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:IntentionalMode`  

**Subclass of:** `gmeow:IntentionalMoment`, `gufo:IntrinsicMode`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/teleology>
